name: procedural-rocks-cliffs
title_zh: 地形上长出的岩壁与碎石，拓扑水密且可交互重算
tagline_zh: 要岩层、崖壁、碎石群与地形严丝合缝地融合，还得拓扑水密、能拖拽调参秒级重算——这套生成器专治这类「既要又要」的硬骨…
tagline_en: Need rock strata, cliffs, and scree that fuse seamlessly with terrain—watertight topology, draggable params.
desc_en: Build or revise procedural rock fields, cliffs, and terrain-bound stone masses in Three.js when fused geological forms, watertight topology, scalable quality, and interactive rebuild latency must agree. Do not use for masonry or isolated decorative rock assets.
why_zh: 不是摆几个石头模型，而是从地形约束里长出来：融合地质形态、水密拓扑、可调质量与交互延迟四件事一起谈。
why_en: Not scattered rock props: it grows geometry from terrain constraints, negotiating fused forms, watertight topology, scalable.
limit_zh: 只做程序化岩体与崖壁，不做砌体墙或孤立装饰石。需要 Three.js 工程环境，且交互重算的延迟目标由你提供。
limit_en: Only procedural rock/cliff masses fused with terrain. No masonry or isolated decorative rocks. Requires a Three.js project; you supply the.
title_en: Procedural rock fields & cliffs that fuse with terrain.
